unsafe_content.description: Detects actionable instructions that could cause harm or enable wrongdoing.

bias_discrimination.description: Detects harmful demographic generalizations and discriminatory recommendations.

confidential_information.description: Detects credentials and other sensitive identifiers in the response.

unsupported_claim.description: Flags strong factual claims that lack support in the supplied context.

hallucination.description: Flags explicit verification claims or narrow contradictions with supplied context.

access_control.description: Detects disclosure of protected instructions and apparent access-control bypasses.

relevance.description: Checks simple requested output formats and instruction-following cues.

toxicity.description: Detects direct insults and abusive language aimed at a person.
